race.title: PricedUp Bet Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: GALLIVANTED produced his best effort yet over hurdles when second over C&D 2 weeks ago and from the same mark, he could be the way to go with his stable starting to hit form. Virtual Rock and Cayman Dancer are in-form rivals, while Blues Singer may up his game this season. GALLIVANTED (FR) BLUES SINGER CAYMAN DANCER
